title: The tools exist now for us to create networks free from corporate control and spying from our own websites. We can still use social media as outreach
summary: The tools exist now for us to create networks free from corporate control and spying from our own websites. We can still use social media as outreach but as educators we should be modeling a better way. We also need our students to start shaping their truth online
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The tools exist now for us to create networks free from corporate control and spying from our own websites. We can still use social media as outreach but as educators we should be modeling a better way.

We also need our students to start shaping their truth online
